title: Shortened cyclic fields with occupancy after exact noise-weight removals with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit 7-field degree-143 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-31 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 58259087342271339/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=9696361624460279422243547028650437618068727928854685112391908 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(101297/500).

experiments.purpose: Check QR profiles, field, orbits, work and the first three signed pair cutoffs (0), the remaining seven pair cutoffs (1), child noise shells and the early proper shells (2), and the full occupancy and error remainder (3).
